name: Familial Steroid-Resistant Nephrotic Syndrome with Sensorineural Deafness
aliases: Steroid-Resistant Nephrotic Syndrome with Hearing Loss

ethnicAssociations: various ethnic groups, with some familial clustering

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnosis of Familial SRNS with Sensorineural Deafness

criteria.description: Persistent nephrotic-range proteinuria unresponsive to steroid therapy
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss confirmed by audiometry
Positive family history of nephrotic syndrome and/or sensorineural deafness
Identification of pathogenic mutations in genes associated with SRNS and deafness (e.g., WT1, LAMB2, or others)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome with bilateral sensorineural hearing loss plus either positive family history or pathogenic mutation in relevant gene
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Renal biopsy may show focal segmental glomerulosclerosis or diffuse mesangial sclerosis.

searchTerms: heavy protein loss in urine not improved by steroids
severe proteinuria resistant to steroid treatment
hearing loss from nerve damage both ears
high blood pressure from kidney problems
blood pressure increase due to kidney issues

occasional.symptomName: Fatigue related to chronic kidney disease
searchTerms: fatigue linked to chronic kidney failure
low energy due to kidney problems

rare.symptomName: Ocular abnormalities (e.g., cataracts or retinal changes)
searchTerms: eye problems like cataracts or retina changes
seizure activity as a neurological sign

rare.symptomName: Thromboembolic events secondary to nephrotic syndrome
searchTerms: blood clots caused by kidney disease
clot formation linked to kidney protein loss

laboratory: Elevated serum creatinine in progressive disease
imaging: Renal ultrasound may show normal or reduced kidney size
Audiometry confirming bilateral sensorineural hearing loss
other: Renal biopsy showing focal segmental glomerulosclerosis or diffuse mesangial sclerosis

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of hematuria from early childhood
Characteristic basement membrane changes on electron microscopy
Early onset nephrotic syndrome with diffuse mesangial sclerosis

redFlags: Onset of nephrotic syndrome in infancy or early childhood
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss in a patient with nephrotic syndrome
references: Bierzynska A, Saleem MA. Nephrotic syndrome in children: clinical significance of genetic advances. Nat Rev Nephrol. 2017;13(2): 131-145.
